SimplifiedChinese.format: Custom Float 将 Word 0 拆分为 uint16、uint8 和 8 个 bit 通道，将 Word 1、2 按小端补码拆分为 int8、int16、int8 和 int32 通道；更短的帧直接输出已匹配部分，帧尾前的后续 Word 各自沿用 JustFloat 输出一个 float 通道。
SimplifiedChinese.example:
unsigned char frame[20] = {0x34, 0x12, 0x56, 0xA5, 0x80, 0x00, 0x80, 0xFF, 0xFC, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x00, 0x00, 0x20, 0x40, 0x00, 0x00, 0x80, 0x7F};
write((char *)frame, sizeof(frame)); // 有符号通道为 -128、-32768、-1、-4；后续 Word 为 2.5f

TraditionalChinese.format: Custom Float 將 Word 0 拆分為 uint16、uint8 和 8 個 bit 通道，將 Word 1、2 按小端補碼拆分為 int8、int16、int8 和 int32 通道；更短的幀直接輸出已匹配部分，幀尾前的後續 Word 各自沿用 JustFloat 輸出一個 float 通道。
TraditionalChinese.example:
unsigned char frame[20] = {0x34, 0x12, 0x56, 0xA5, 0x80, 0x00, 0x80, 0xFF, 0xFC, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x00, 0x00, 0x20, 0x40, 0x00, 0x00, 0x80, 0x7F};
write((char *)frame, sizeof(frame)); // 有符號通道為 -128、-32768、-1、-4；後續 Word 為 2.5f

English.format: Custom Float splits Word 0 into uint16, uint8, and eight bit channels, then decodes Words 1 and 2 as little-endian two's-complement int8, int16, int8, and int32 channels. Shorter frames emit only matched data; every later Word before the frame tail retains JustFloat behavior and emits one float channel.
English.example:
unsigned char frame[20] = {0x34, 0x12, 0x56, 0xA5, 0x80, 0x00, 0x80, 0xFF, 0xFC, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x00, 0x00, 0x20, 0x40, 0x00, 0x00, 0x80, 0x7F};
write((char *)frame, sizeof(frame)); // signed channels: -128, -32768, -1, -4; later Word: 2.5f
